name: Workspace navigation
summary: A workspace switcher, search, grouped links, and an account card in a column that folds to an icon rail beside the page, and opens as a drawer on a narrow container.

useWhen: Moving between a few grouped sections of one workspace from a persistent column
Folding the column to icons to give the page content more room
avoidWhen: The links are a short list of contextual links or the primary navigation of a site
Each link routes to a different URL and the page needs a router

accessibility: The column is a complementary landmark named Workspace and its links sit in a navigation landmark named Workspace links, both by aria-label; the main pane is a section named by its heading. Rename all three for your content.
The fold button sets aria-expanded and controls the column by id, and Cmd or Ctrl plus B does the same except while focus is in a text field or editor.
A folded rail keeps every link's full name and shows it in a tooltip on hover and keyboard focus.
Nested groups are native disclosures, and the current link carries aria-current.
Below 40rem of container width the navigation opens from a header button as a dialog named Navigation that holds focus and returns it to the button on close.
The workspace menu button keeps a transparent outline beside its focus ring, so the outline still shows where forced colors drop the shadow.
unsupported: Routing: every link is a #fragment and the current link is fixed in the source
Remembering the folded state: it is local state that resets on reload
Switching workspaces: the menu items do nothing until you add handlers
Searching: the Search field filters nothing
Live counts: the badges are placeholders
workflowValue: Replaces wiring a navigation column, its fold, and a mobile drawer by hand: one Provider holds the folded state for the rail, the fold button, and the shortcut, and one set of links fills both the column and the drawer, so you swap the links and keep the shell.
